notes.title: Patch Notes - 07/26/18
notes.content:
Hey chickys, we've made a number of updates in this patch and a minor patch released last week:
[list]
[*]Replaced mouse cursor with aiming reticule which is easier to see
[*]Fixed an issue that forced the resolution to be 720p
[*]Updated Russian translations
[*]Game now saves after dying on a level
[*]Increased hitboxes for all enemies
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25448448/f74fe77321422ae661bbd2f78583ede20f353eab.gif[/img]

notes.title: Chicken Assassin: Reloaded Released
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25448448/047aeba0b701e7beb7ec0f7efb91e09311800b4c.png[/img]

Get your fighting outfit on! Chicken Assassin: Reloaded in now available on Steam!  
If you already own the game, don’t be afraid, this is coming to you as a free update! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25448448/bcf0ccb4b0ddf2b15ea7742def984007fe54200c.gif[/img]


Some new things that you can look forward to with this release are: 
[list]
[*]New Mission - The First Siege
[*]New Game Mode - Endless Mode - Survive an onslaught of the most difficult enemies in a brand new game mode that will test your endurance…you may want to use the bathroom before attempting
[*]New languages - German, Spanish, Russian, and French
[*]Enemy and Environment updates - altered character designs
[*]Bug Fixes
[*]Linux and Mac Versions[/list]

notes.title: Major Update: Trading Cards! Achievements! New Wardrobe Items Added!
notes.content:
[b]Here's what you'll find in our July 7th Update:[/b]

Players asked for Trading Cards, Badges, Emotes, Backgrounds and all the Steam Extras - they are now live! Collect them all ːsteamhappyː

We have patiently waiting for video response from some major Youtubers, so instead, we chose to add them into the game as hilarious masks!  You can find the faces of Social Media icons unlocking in the first mission of the game and the rest is a secret. Go back and replay these to find them!

Bug was reported regarding Rooster Tales achievements not being incremented on two missions, this was squashed!

This pretty much covers it.ːsteammockingː
